Subject: Performance deep-dive: proposed slots & agenda

Hi Ben / Maya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused performance/latency deep-dive with your infra and app teams to validate token throughput targets for the demo next month. High-level asks:

- 90-min session: architecture review + a short live load test (dry run + one full run)
- primary objectives: confirm steady-state tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency at target prompt lengths, and KV-cache warmup behavior
- prelim targets from your side: 120k tokens/sec sustained (across 8 GPUs) and p95 <= 350ms for 1k-context prompts

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Dec 3, 13:00–14:30
- Mon Dec 7, 09:00–10:30

Agenda (attached: loadtest-plan-v1.pdf):
1) 10m — intros & success criteria
2) 20m — architecture walk (models, routing, quantization profile)
3) 25m — runbook & failure modes (timeouts, OOMs, fallback)
4) 35m — live dry-run + full run (metrics capture)

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will participate (ops, app, SRE)? We can also invite Dylan and Karthik from our infra team to present runbook details.

Thanks,
Priya

Team —

Ben asked for the exact model variant and a short pre-check list. Can you confirm the following and I will send a single-page checklist to ACME:

- model: gptx-13b-compat, int8 quant profile (q6k) — Karthik to confirm final kernel flags
- target during run: 120k tokens/sec sustained across 8xA100-equivalent instances (we'll run with partitioned KV cache)
- instrumentation: Prometheus + Grafana (token counters: ri_tokens_total, ri_token_latency_seconds)
- pre-checks: NIC MTU 9000, iommu disabled on test hosts, latest cudnn/cuquantlib, driver >= 525.60
- runbook note: if p95 > 500ms we fallback to a lower batch size and capture full traces

Also, can Dylan and Karthik confirm ownership of the warmup script and slot-hold invite (.ics) so I can include attachments?

Thanks — I'll aim to reply to Ben with a concise checklist and confirm Dec 3 13:00 PST if we have approvals.

-Priya

Priya / Karthik —

I own the warmup script; attaching a stub here (kv-warmup-script.sh). Quick technical notes for the checklist (I'll paste into the final doc):
- warmup: sequential prefix loading for the KV store to reach steady-state; warmup takes ~120s per host at our standard batch sizes
- expected steady-state: ~115–130k tokens/sec depending on prompt length distribution; our last internal run peaked at 135k but sustained closer to 118k with real prompt mix
- observability endpoints: /metrics (Prom), /traces (Jaeger) — ensure ACME's network ACLs allow inbound from our test harness IPs
- failure handling: if OOMs occur, immediate rollback to q6k-slim profile and half batch-size, then retry once.

Attaching: kv-warmup-script.sh (1.2KB) and adding a couple of sample grafana panels to the drive link.

-Dylan
